Have you had numbness or loss of sensation?
Have you had problems with balance or walking?
Have you had episodes of loss of awareness or blackouts?
Have you had difficulty speaking or swallowing?
Have you noticed changes in memory, concentration, mood, or behavior?
Has anyone in your family had similar movements or an inherited neurologic illness?
Have you recently taken an antipsychotic, anti-nausea, antidepressant, or other dopamine-blocking medication?
Did the movements start after a physical injury, illness, or major psychological stress?
Are the movements substantially less noticeable when you are distracted?
Do the movements become worse when someone watches or examines you?
